title: Edit is grayed on a shared matrix, with a link to the matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing two new categories made for this test, category A and category B.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Point at the grayed Edit.
  4. Click "Go to the" link beside Edit.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click category A's name in the breadcrumb.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit above the grid is grayed.
  • Beside it a link reads "Go to the", matrix A's name, "matrix".
  • Category B is also on matrix A, so the grid is shared.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip reads "Can't edit here. The", matrix A's name, "matrix prices 2 categories, so edit it from the matrix."

Step 4:

  • Matrix A's page opens with its grid already in edit.

Step 5:

  • The grid returns to view.

Step 6:

  • Category A's page opens again.
